in_marathi.name: Sumanta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sumanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘suma’ which means ‘good’ and ‘anta’ which means ‘governance’. It signifies good governance, intelligent rule, and wise decision making.
